title: Taylor flying cargo jets between Florida and Nassau

tellings.quote: you know, he writes in Launch Fever, his biography about flying these cargo jets back and forth between Florida and Nassau,

plain: Before his later fame, a man named Timothy Taylor, whom NASA is said to have studied because UFOs seem to show up around him, flew cargo jets back and forth between Florida and Nassau in the Bahamas. Michels says Taylor writes about this himself in Launch Fever, his biography.
